marketing_wrapper: Minimal: white backdrop, a bold dark slate two-line caption with a full stop, and a black-bezel iPhone. Real UI is ~75% of each image. All six are real app screens.

typography.display: Captions in a heavy rounded-terminal grotesk in dark slate (#1c2b33-like), consistent with Meta's Optimistic Display (unsure); in-app the conversation title in the top bar is semibold ~17pt
typography.body: unsure: a neutral grotesk close to Meta's Optimistic Text or SF; cannot separate at this size
typography.weights: Regular body; bold inline labels and section heads in answers ('Today at a glance', 'Shelf-Worthy Staples'); semibold top-bar title
typography.case_and_tracking: Sentence case; default tracking; captions end with full stops

palette.accent_strategy: One accent: Meta blue on the voice/send button and 'See all' links. A small purple-to-indigo multi-petal glyph marks 'Show thinking'. Semantic green for 'Open'. Otherwise white and light grey.
palette.source: palette.json 01–06: #ffffff 54–76% = app canvas and backdrop; #e1e1e2 / #f4f5f5 = bubbles and controls; #191b1d / #24272a / #1f211e = text and caption. Pixel samples: voice button #006bf1 (01), thinking glyph #b341f9 to #564fb6 (01), user bubble #f4f4f6 (03), caption #172d38-ish (01), 'Open' green #1fb62b (02).

shape.radius_language: pill and large: user bubbles ~20pt, composer panel with ~24pt top corners, circular buttons, pill 'Thinking' chip, map/product cards ~16–20pt, device settings tiles full pill
shape.borders_shadows: Soft shadows on the floating top buttons, the map place card and the settings tiles; hairline outline on the 'Thinking' chip and mic button
shape.materials: Frosted glass on the Instant/Thinking popover and the iOS 26 keyboard (06); floating capsule top bar

liquid_glass_visible: yes: the model popover (Instant / Thinking) in 06 is a frosted glass panel, the keyboard is the iOS 26 glass keyboard, and the top circle/capsule buttons float over scrolled content (02 shows text passing beneath them).
density: medium: answers are long, markdown-structured briefings with bullets; product carousels and map cards inline
layout: Thread with a conversation title in the top bar: right-aligned light-grey user bubbles, a 'Show thinking >' row with the purple glyph, bubble-less assistant markdown, rich cards (map with pins and a place carousel, product carousel). Other screens: an AI glasses hub (device image, battery, setting tiles, gallery, reminders) and an image-preset Library (segmented Presets / Created / Imported, 2-column grid).
navigation: Circular hamburger top-left with the chat title beside it; capsule with new-chat pen and overflow top-right (or settings + add on the glasses screen). No tab bar. Composer is a bottom panel: 'Ask Meta AI…' on top, then '+', a 'Thinking' mode chip, mic and a blue voice circle.
imagery_and_icons: Outline monoline icons; product photography and AI-generated images; a 3D-rendered product image of the glasses; the purple multi-petal glyph as the AI marker.
signature_visual_move: A purple petal glyph labelled 'Show thinking' above an otherwise ChatGPT-identical white thread.
tells_present: Gestalt sameness: 'they all look the same'

direction_fit.why: The chat surface is a clone of ChatGPT down to the chrome (circular menu button, pen + overflow capsule, blue voice circle). But the Discover/Vibes feed that defines the text record's 'Feed-Grafted' tag appears nowhere; the store set sells a daily briefing, local search, shopping, AI glasses and an image-preset library instead. The graft is now a device hub and a preset grid, not a social feed.

notes: Composer: a white bottom panel with rounded top corners (two rows: placeholder, then '+', 'Thinking' outlined pill, outlined mic circle, blue filled voice circle with waveform); on the glasses screen it shrinks to a '+' circle and a pill field. With the keyboard up (06) the mode chip opens a glass popover with 'Instant — Answers right away' and 'Thinking — Reasons longer before answering', and the voice button becomes a blue send arrow. Greeting/empty state: not shown. Voice: only the blue waveform button; no orb visible. Thinking: a collapsed 'Show thinking >' row with the purple glyph above each answer, i.e. reasoning on demand, which matches the module requirement. Streaming: not shown (a scroll-down chevron floats mid-answer in 01). Conversation list: not shown (drawer). The thinking glyph is labelled, so it avoids the unlabelled-sparkle tell.
